summary: Implemented and measured a default-off page-delta mode on top of RETROINFER_BLOCK_CACHE_SLOT_ROTATION=1. The bounded mechanism probe and the canonical 120K x batch8 x cache_ratio 0.05 x gen_len 100 run both passed NIAH correctness with true page-delta telemetry: path_executed=true, CPU full-KV owner bytes reported, actual GPU slot count 8<=m, zero full-layer H2D/D2H transfers, nonzero page H2D/D2H transfers, final pending transfers zero, and no ownership/page-index/generation violations. The canonical performance result refutes the idea: opt036 kept opt035 memory residency and reduced opt035 slot-rotation transfer bytes by 80.36%, but decode throughput fell to 1.761 tok/s versus 25.039 tok/s for opt035 and 198.836 tok/s for baseline.

environment.runtime_verdict: Project .venv is required and works: Python 3.11.15, torch 2.5.1+cu124, CUDA runtime available on NVIDIA A100 80GB PCIe, and retroinfer_kernels imports pass.

source_rebuild_status.notes: Runtime uses installed cu124 extensions. Source rebuild was not attempted because nvcc is CUDA 12.0, not a proven CUDA 12.4 compiler.

frontier_refresh.conclusion: Recent systems and docs support page/block-granular KV offload and dirty/needed page transfer over full-layer migration; opt035 full-layer PCIe rotation is not reused as a speed candidate.

implementation.default_api_behavior: Unset RETROINFER_BLOCK_CACHE_SLOT_ROTATION preserves the existing default path; RETROINFER_BLOCK_CACHE_SLOT_ROTATION=1 without RETROINFER_BLOCK_CACHE_SLOT_ROTATION_DELTA preserves opt035 full-layer slot rotation.
implementation.mechanism: CPU pinned full logical block-cache K/V remains owner. GPU allocates fixed slot tensors and layer aliases. In delta mode, WaveBuffer hit page IDs drive CPU-owner to slot page H2D immediately before gather_copy_and_concat, and update_cache_indices drive slot to CPU-owner dirty page D2H after gather_copy_and_scatter/admission completion.

canonical_measurement.command: env -u RETROINFER_INDEX_METADATA_PREFILL_RESIDENCY -u RETROINFER_STAGE_INDEX_METADATA_LAYERS -u RETROINFER_STREAM_ONLY_LAYERS -u RETROINFER_LAYER_CACHE_RESIDENCY -u RETROINFER_LAYER_CACHE_CAPACITY_SCALE -u RETROINFER_ASYNC_STREAM_ONLY_GATHER -u RETROINFER_LATE_INDEX_METADATA_MIGRATION_POLICY -u RETROINFER_BLOCK_CACHE_ALLOCATION_POLICY -u RETROINFER_LATE_BLOCK_CACHE_INIT -u RETROINFER_ASYNC_CACHE_ADMISSION -u RETROINFER_ASYNC_WAVE_BATCH_ACCESS -u RETROINFER_ASYNC_CLUSTER_ID_COPY -u RETROINFER_BUFFER_NPROBE_MULTIPLIER -u RETROINFER_BUFFER_PAGES_PER_CLUSTER_FLOOR -u RETROINFER_WAVE_BUFFER_CORE_OVERRIDE -u RETROINFER_PAGES_PER_CLUSTER_OVERRIDE -u RETROINFER_SCRATCH_BUFFER_INIT RETROINFER_BLOCK_CACHE_SLOT_ROTATION=1 RETROINFER_BLOCK_CACHE_SLOT_ROTATION_DELTA=1 RETROINFER_BLOCK_CACHE_GPU_SLOTS=8 RETROINFER_CACHE_TELEMETRY=1 .venv/bin/python throughput_eval/reproduce_block_cache.py --suite opt036_delta_page_slot_rotation --context-batch-groups 120000x8 --cache-ratios 0.05 --baseline-cache-ratio 0.05 --rounds 1 --gen-len 100 --retrieval-budget 0.018 --estimation-budget 0.232 --seed 2025 --cuda-visible-devices 0 --require-idle-gpu --stop-on-error --output-dir attempts/opt_attempt_036_delta_page_slot_rotation/raw/harness_120k_b8_cr0p05

limitations: Only one canonical round was run because this was a bounded mechanism/performance check after the bounded probe.
The idea is performance-refuted: page-delta moved fewer bytes than opt035 but performs many Python-level page-slice copies and is much slower at the canonical 120K batch=8 shape.
CUDA/C++ kernels were not rebuilt because no CUDA 12.4 compiler was proven available.
